content: Questions from the training, development, and test sets were randomly shuffled to counterbalance any learning effects during the annotation procedure, but were presented in grade order (3rd to 9th grade) to reduce context switching (a given grade level tends to use a similar subset of the taxonomy – for example, 3rd grade questions generally do not address Chemical Equations or Newtons 1st Law of Motion).
